create.name: Marc Stuart
create.bio:
Marc Stuart is a Scottish Spiritualist medium who works from Penicuik, just south of Edinburgh, where he keeps a reading room, and who styles himself 'The Scottish Medium'. He is one of the resident mediums at Dunfermline Spiritualist Church and has served on Spiritualist platforms abroad, including the Lily Dale community in New York State, other churches in the United States, and private gatherings in Xi'an, China. Before turning to mediumship full time he trained in business and accountancy, and he still runs a small marketing service for mediums.

His teaching follows what he calls a Scottish, evidence-led style of mediumship: first give clear details that the sitter can recognise, then pass on the message. He believes the skill is learned by sitting in a development circle week after week with a leader who gives feedback after every reading, and he offers weekly circles and structured six- and twelve-month trainings for people who want to work as mediums. A free network of open circles, Sunday events and rapid-fire demonstrations, with paid Patreon tiers for lectures and training videos, sits alongside private readings by Zoom or in person.

courses.title: Full training as a Medium over one year
courses.description: A twelve-month development path built on weekly circle sittings, with feedback after each message, aimed at people who want to work professionally as mediums. Entry is after a short interview with his training adviser.
courses.price: $1,015 USD up front or $99 USD a month for 12 months

courses.title: Full training as a Medium over six months
courses.description: The same route to working as a professional medium, completed over six months instead of a year, with the same weekly circle-based feedback.
courses.price: $1,015 USD up front or $199 USD a month for 6 months

courses.title: Circle Membership for one circle a week
courses.description: Ongoing membership of one online development circle a week, for people who sense spirit and want to learn to turn impressions into clear messages.

courses.title: Patreon memberships: lectures and training videos
courses.description: Paid Patreon tiers that add a weekly half-hour lecture series, longer pieces on Scotland and Spiritualism, practical training videos and, at the top tier, extra live sessions.
courses.price: $75 USD or $125 USD a month (free tier available)

courses.title: Online Zoom Reading UK
courses.description: A one-hour private mediumship reading on Zoom, recorded for the sitter; readings are also given in person at his Penicuik reading room.

free_resources.title: The Marc Stuart Medium Network
free_resources.description: His free network with online demonstrations, two open circles a month, weekly discussions and Sunday events, open to anyone curious about evidential mediumship.

flags: Base is Penicuik (Midlothian, about 16 km south of Edinburgh city centre), from the head-office address on his contact page and his in-person reading room there; the queue entry had Glasgow, which was wrong.
His site says the business is owned by Niagara Falls (Residential) Limited trading as Marc Stuart Medium, and he also runs a marketing agency for mediums (Cailleach); left out of the items.
His reading pages ask sitters to treat readings 'as entertainment to comply with UK law'.
Patreon is the main home of his paid content; the Patreon offering links to his own mediumship-training page (Patreon not opened).
YouTube avatar is a logo, so photos come from his own site (home page portrait first, then his team-page photo); same man in both.
Two offering titles end with a full stop in the URL slug as published on his site.
Channel subscriber count is small (136); Facebook, where he says he streams, was not read.
Emoji removed from two video titles (🎥, 🌟); wording otherwise as published.
left_out: In-person readings at his Penicuik reading room (£50 GBP) and home visits: covered by the Zoom reading item.
Psychic Mondays and onlinemediumreadings.com: separate reading services, not opened.
Dated rapid-fire demonstrations, open-circle recordings tied to dates, travel vlogs, news updates and Dog Tarot card videos on YouTube.
Cailleach marketing services for mediums: business service, not spiritual teaching.
Planned trips (Wales, China, Florida, London, 2027 tours): no bookable pages.
